templates.name: 待办清单
templates.description: 添加、完成与本地持久化任务管理
templates.prompt: Build a modern todo list app with add task, mark complete, and local storage persistence. Clean SaaS UI.

templates.name: SaaS 落地页
templates.description: Hero、功能介绍与行动号召的营销页
templates.prompt: Create a SaaS landing page for an AI productivity tool with hero section, three feature cards, and call-to-action buttons.

templates.name: 数据分析面板
templates.description: KPI 卡片与图表的业务指标面板
templates.prompt: Build an analytics dashboard with sidebar navigation, KPI metric cards showing revenue/users/sessions, and a weekly activity bar chart.

templates.name: 在线商店
templates.description: 商品展示、购物车与结账流程
templates.prompt: Create an e-commerce storefront with product grid, product detail modal, shopping cart sidebar, and checkout summary.

templates.name: 产品目录
templates.description: 分类筛选与搜索的商品目录
templates.prompt: Build a product catalog with category filters, search bar, sort options, and responsive product cards.

templates.name: 计算器
templates.description: 基础四则运算的交互式计算器
templates.prompt: Create a sleek calculator app with basic arithmetic operations (+, -, ×, ÷), clear, and percentage functions.

templates.name: 库存管理
templates.description: SKU 追踪与低库存预警
templates.prompt: Build an internal inventory management tool with SKU list, stock in/out logs, and low-stock alerts.

templates.name: 开发者作品集
templates.prompt: Build a developer portfolio page with hero intro, skills section, project cards grid, and contact button.

templates.name: 天气组件
templates.prompt: Create a weather app widget showing current temperature, conditions, and a city search input with mock weather data.

templates.name: 个人日记
templates.description: 日记条目与 mood 追踪
templates.prompt: Build a personal journal app with daily entries, mood tracking emoji picker, and calendar view.
